newsitem.title: USA: Spectra fiber now produced by three companies.
newsitem.headline: Spectra fiber now produced by three companies.

text.p: Three companies now have capacity to produce 2.7 to 3.2 million pounds a year of the composites used in AlliedSignal Inc's Spectra Fiber, spokesman John Mallen said Monday.
Earlier, AlliedSignal said it will build a plant that will double production of its high-strength Spectra Fiber and Spectra Shield composites.
Mallen said the plant will be located in the U.S. southeast, adding the location should be announced this fall.
The other producers are Toyobo Co Ltd and DSM NV, he said.
Mallen declined to say what AlliedSignal's current capacity is, but noted the company is "sold out."
The company said it is the worldwide patent holder of Spectra Shield and SpectraFlex.

Allied said its new production is scheduled to begin operations in the third quarter of 1997, with about half its capacity in production. It will be in full-scale operation about a year later. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
